note: Citations + working fetch recipes for sources the corpus cites but does not hold (copyrighted or gated). The corpus vends PD/open sources and points at the rest; the reader fetches locally into .pointer-cache/ (git-ignored). Every entry's recipe must resolve live — a dead pointer is corrected or deleted, never left as decoration. See pointers/README.md.

pointers.title: Religious Texts from Ugarit (Baal Cycle, Keret, Aqhat — English translation)
pointers.author: N. Wyatt
pointers.era: pre-0 (Ugaritic texts c. 14th–12th c. BCE; this edition 2002)
pointers.rights_evidence: Internet Archive scan states no license; the book is © 2002 Sheffield Academic Press / Continuum. The archive.org copy is a scan of a copyrighted work.
pointers.why_pointer: The only readable whole rendering reachable is this copyrighted edition. The original-language transliteration has an OPEN vendorable home (Copenhagen Ugaritic Corpus, github.com/DT-UCPH/cuc, CC BY-NC 4.0) — this pointer exists for the ENGLISH reading in the meantime.
pointers.falsifying_control: If the archive.org item is removed or the djvu.txt 404s, the pointer is dead and must be re-pointed or deleted. If the item's rights are clarified as open, it moves from a pointer to a vendored source.

pointers.title: Die altägyptischen Pyramidentexte (hieroglyphic edition, vols)
pointers.author: Kurt Sethe
pointers.era: pre-0 (Old Egyptian, c. 2350–2100 BCE; this edition 1908–22)
pointers.rights_evidence: Internet Archive item metadata possible-copyright-status: NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT; published 1908–22, author d. 1934 — public domain by age.
pointers.why_pointer: PD, but the scan's OCR yields no machine-readable text (the DjVu text contains no Unicode hieroglyphs). Vendoring the BYTES (PDF/JP2) is possible; the extractable text is not usable, so a reader fetches the OCR to see the plates live. A proper vendored hold would transcribe the plates via the eoreader7 CV loop.
pointers.falsifying_control: If a machine-readable open transliteration of the Pyramid Texts is found, it supersedes this pointer and is vendored instead. If the archive item changes id, re-resolve.

pointers.why_pointer: The clearest readable transliteration + English rendering available; copyrighted, so cited not copied.
pointers.falsifying_control: A license statement appearing on the site, or a PD alternative reaching parity, moves this out of the pointer tier.

pointers.title: Zohar (Aramaic/Hebrew, vocalized edition)
pointers.author: attributed to Moses de León
pointers.rights_evidence: Sefaria API: the English is The Zohar (Soncino 1933), license Public Domain / Sefaria Community Translation CC0; the Hebrew/Aramaic 'Vocalized Zohar, Israel 2013' reports heLicense = unknown (underlying 13th-c. text PD; the 2013 digitization unlicensed).
